scope: Validated expanded/compact periodic HATCH adapters, supplied periodic-domain evaluation and prevalidated CreateBoundary association changes.
limits: No native AutoCAD execution or rendering qualification.
Expanded K=M+p+1 packets require exact bitwise degree-fold coordinate/weight continuation; legacy compact K=N+2p+1 HATCH packets are compatibility storage only.
Degree 1 through 10, at least degree+1 compact controls, positive finite weights and strictly increasing supplied knots are required for qualified conversion/evaluation.
Cyclic span tolerance is 1e-12 relative to compared positive spans, with no fixed absolute floor. Repeated knots and guessed knot/control rotations are unsupported.
Nonrational HATCH flags with nonunit stored weights reject conversion without tightening storage, cloning or direct transform admission.
Weight normalization underflow, nonrepresentable denominators/results and aliased or underflowed periodic sampling grids reject. These numerical guards are confined to periodic evaluation.

96 canonical drawings are audited: 48 expanded HATCH drawings and 48 separate standalone-only drawings exported from legacy compact cases. The 48 compact HATCH compatibility drawings and 26 unsupported packet storage drawings have no native-validity claim.
Application callback exceptions during a successful commit remain outside the unsupported-input prevalidation guarantee.

independent_parent_review.scope: Independent numerical and actual-wire review of periodic HATCH conversion and generated standalone SPLINE curves
independent_parent_review.method: Homogeneous de Boor recurrence and manually constructed OCS frame, using actual producer DXF control/weight/knot arrays. No owner verifier helper or manifest expected sample data imported. Actual standalone arrays and emitted netDxf evaluation samples compared independently.
limits: 48 legacy compact HATCH drawings (576 periodic packets) are explicitly storage-only; their separately emitted canonical standalone drawings are audited.
This review covers twelve degree1/2/3 periodic producer packets in all six supported profiles, both transports, both plane choices, both link modes and both retained packet forms.
Native CAD execution and other periodic knot layouts remain unqualified.
independent_parent_review.provisional: provisional-result.json is historical setup evidence only; final-result supersedes it and counts are not additive.

summary.module: Periodic HATCH conversion and evaluation: independent source-boundary review
source_review: The expanded adapter removes exactly the degree-sized prefix only when the knot/control count relation identifies that form; exact coordinate/weight overlap is checked first. The compact compatibility relation does not lose a second prefix. Both preserve the supplied knot sequence.

The standalone periodic validator requires positive finite weights and strictly increasing finite knots, bounds the active period and compares all 2p exterior spans to the supplied cyclic continuation with a relative tolerance and no absolute floor.

Periodic evaluation uses the active domain before the ordinary closed-control condition, normalizes only a temporary weight array, validates denominator/results and rejects unrepresentable parameter grids. The nonperiodic path remains separate.

CreateBoundary prepares all converted world-coordinate entities before unlinking old contours or changing associativity. Periodic world-transform overflow is validated before commit. Exceptions in caller callbacks during successful commit remain outside the documented prevalidation guarantee.
runtime_controls: Two valid finite standalone tangent vectors overflow during their OCS projection. Both start/end conversions reject through the existing finite tangent setter and preserve the source, so no additional production fix is needed.

Eight combinations of prior association, requested linking and late failure preserve complete drawing membership, source occurrences, reactors, path/edge arrays, association state and seed with zero callbacks. The late failures are incompatible cyclic spans and world-coordinate overflow after otherwise valid conversion.

Two tiny-domain controls at 1e-150 scale verify a valid cyclic packet evaluates to finite samples while a 1e-156 exterior-span mismatch rejects. The input knots remain unchanged, demonstrating the check has no fixed absolute tolerance floor.
summary.scope: No production defect found. Root separately owns the full independent producer/curve/sample replay. These 12 controls per configuration supplement that proof without claiming additional native CAD execution or qualifying the legacy compact HATCH wire as canonical DXF.
